the food and beverage industries' responses to the government consultation on product formulation in 2014 illustrate four categories of corporate political strategy: participation in the process, framing of the nutrition debate, creating partnerships and influencing the interpretation and use of evidence.
the food and beverage product reformulations that are currently being made are part of a larger corporate political strategy to influence public policy and public health decisions.

the food and beverage companies' narratives and frames around reformulation are aligned with a taxonomy of corporate political strategies that we have developed, and are therefore similar to previous industry strategies to shape public health policy.

the food and beverage industries' strategic use of product reformulation to influence nutrition policy.
the ways in which the food and beverage industries are using product reformulation to influence the nutrition policy process in the U.S.
the strategic uses of reformulating food and beverage products to influence nutrition policies and public health decisions.

the industry's responses in the consultation illustrate a range of strategies that align with the taxonomy.
product reformulation is not a neutral response to obesity and noncommunicables diseases.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
product reformulation is an industry strategy that is used to shape public health policy and to influence the public health debate.
the food and beverage companies are not only using product reformulation to address public health issues but also using it as a tool to influence public policies and public opinion in their favor.

food and beverage corporations use reformulation as a strategic tool to influence public health policy, in a manner consistent with the broader literature on food and beverage industry political strategy.

the food and beverage sector's voluntary reformulation efforts are likely to be part of a corporate political strategy, and should be considered in the broader context of the industry's efforts to shape public health policy.
